_comment: Extends check-reference-links.mjs built-in ignores (AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md, decisions.md, architecture.md, copilot-instructions.md, and the NNNN-*.md template placeholder). Add a name here only when docs legitimately NAME a filename that is not an in-tree reference file (a teaching example, a template placeholder). For a one-off example on a single line, prefer an inline 'link-check:ignore' on that line instead.
